w2:textbox.label:
1. Click the addSchedule() button below to add a schedule. (Alternatively, click any date and add a schedule.)
2. Confirm that the onaddschedule event is triggered.
3. Drag the added schedule on the calendar to move it.
4. Confirm that the onmoveschedule event is triggered.
(Each event handler can be checked in the Script tab.)

Event Description

onaddschedule - Fired when a schedule is added.
onmoveschedule - Fired when a schedule is moved.

/// Sample Code

scwin.count = 0;

scwin.trigger1_onclick = function (e) {
   var dateStr = WebSquare.date.getCurrentServerDate("yyyyMMdd");
   var addDate = WebSquare.date.dateAdd(dateStr, 3);

   scheduleCalendar1.addSchedule({
       "title": "My Schedule",
       "start": dateStr,
       "end": addDate,
       "id": scwin.count
   });
   scwin.count++;
};
